description: Fix text truncation and small badges (Issues 8-11): Remove max-w-[160px] and truncate classes from book-title badges in ParentFeedbackSection, upgrade text-[10px] to text-xs (12px minimum), allow text to wrap or use line-clamp-2. Independent of other FEATs.

Verify the badge text now wraps naturally or use line-clamp-2 if multi-line is acceptable: 'text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800 bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl line-clamp-2'
Check if similar truncate patterns exist in BookCard.tsx, Navbar.tsx dropdown, or other components – apply same fix pattern
